svg.aria-label: Generate once, seed on boot, invite through join: 1. Generate: The Password generator makes the admin password and the Wizarr API key once. PushSecret records both in 1Password item wizarr. 2. Seed: An init container runs the database upgrade, then seed.py. It writes the admin, the Plex server, the Seerr connection and the hermes API key. 3. Admin: wizarr.${SECRET_DOMAIN} on envoy-internal serves the admin UI and the health check to LAN and VPN clients only. 4. Join: join.${SECRET_DOMAIN} on envoy-external routes only the invite paths and /favicon.ico. Every other path on that host is not routed. 5. Keep: kopiur snapshots the 1 GiB SQLite claim to R2 each day. Invites and libraries live in that database.
